triggerDialog.description.en: Configure when and how this routine fires.
triggerDialog.description.zh-CN: 配置这个例行任务何时以及如何触发。

triggerDialog.kindImmutable.en: Kind can't be changed after creation.

triggerDialog.labelHelp.en: Optional - shown in the trigger list.
triggerDialog.labelHelp.zh-CN: 可选 - 会显示在触发器列表中。

triggerDialog.signingMode.bearer.en: Expect a shared bearer token in the Authorization header.
triggerDialog.signingMode.bearer.zh-CN: 期望在 Authorization 请求头中收到共享 bearer token。

triggerDialog.signingMode.githubHmac.en: Accept GitHub-style X-Hub-Signature-256 header (HMAC over raw body, no timestamp).
triggerDialog.signingMode.githubHmac.zh-CN: 接受 GitHub 风格的 X-Hub-Signature-256 请求头（基于原始请求体的 HMAC，无时间戳）。

triggerDialog.signingMode.hmacSha256.en: Expect an HMAC SHA-256 signature over the request using the shared secret.
triggerDialog.signingMode.hmacSha256.zh-CN: 期望使用共享密钥对请求生成 HMAC SHA-256 签名。

triggerDialog.signingMode.none.en: No authentication - the webhook URL itself acts as a shared secret.
triggerDialog.signingMode.none.zh-CN: 不做认证 - webhook URL 本身就是共享密钥。
